memory_before.meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agre:
Meridian Credits release "1.0" loyalty credit agreement (Finance-approved; source: issue trial-896 description). Applies to every consumer of release 1.0 (single-line quote, full-statement total, and itemized statement). Release "1.0" is the initial agreement; an omitted request release selects the current agreement (release "2.0" since issue trial-fxq), an explicit supported release selects that version, and versions introduced in an issue stay supported afterward. Public suites send explicit release values, so an earlier-release suite stays valid when the current agreement changes.

Charge line: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id (nonempty strings; line_id unique per request), service_on (YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, never excludes a line), charge_cents (nonnegative integer US cents). Subscription identity is the pair (account_id, subscription_id); a subscription may have several lines. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order = Unicode code-point order. Do not add response keys beyond those specified.

Credit rules (release 1.0): uncapped credit per line = floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), rounded down separately per line. Cap = 2400 cents shared by all lines with the same account_id across its subscriptions; distinct accounts have independent caps. Priority within a cap group: earliest service_on first, ties by increasing line_id; charge size plays no role in priority. Each line gets its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get only the remainder or zero. total_credit = sum of assigned credits; line amount due = charge - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit.

quote command: {"command":"quote","line":LINE} optionally with "release":"1.0". Response has exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; a one-line quote treats the line as the entire statement. Unsupported release -> {"error":"unsupported_release"}.

total command (issue trial-aiw): {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...]} optionally with "release":"1.0". Response has exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents for the whole charge set; the account cap is applied across all supplied lines (not a collection of independent single-line quotes). Empty statement -> {"release":"1.0","credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}. quote remains available alongside total.

statement command with explicit "release":"1.0" (issue trial-525, partner itemized receipts; a consumer of this agreement, not a new agreement): request {"command":"statement","release":"1.0","lines":[LINE,...]}. Response has exactly the existing statement shape: release, lines, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; each response line has exactly line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; lines keep the input order (priority only decides credit assignment, never output order). Uses the original 1.0 cap scope (per account_id across subscriptions) and 1.0 priority (earliest service_on, then line_id). Empty lines -> {"release":"1.0","lines":[],"credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}. One-line example, charge 19999 -> {"release":"1.0","credit_cents":1999,"amount_due_cents":18000,"lines":[{"line_id":"L-1","credit_cents":1999,"amount_due_cents":18000}]}. Statement with omitted release remains the current agreement (2.0).

Implementation: main.py RELEASES["1.0"] holds rate_percent 10, cap_cents 2400, group_key account_id, priority (service_on, line_id); assign_credits(lines, release) is the shared engine for quote(), total() and statement(). Verified 2026-09-07 by tests/test_quote.py, tests/test_total.py, tests/test_statement.py (release 1.0 cases: empty, one-line example, service-date priority, account-wide cap), public_tests/release_1_quote.json, release_1_total.json and release_1_statement.json (all passing).
memory_before.meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-agre:
Meridian Credits release "2.0" loyalty credit agreement (Finance-approved and permanently adopted as the CURRENT agreement; source: issue trial-fxq description). Applies to quote, total and statement with omitted release and to explicit release "2.0". Explicit release "1.0" still uses the original agreement recorded under key meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement (that record remains valid historical/explicit-release knowledge; its "omitted release selects 1.0" statement is superseded by this record). Supported releases: "1.0", "2.0"; unsupported -> {"error":"unsupported_release"}. Response release reports the agreement actually used. Request/response shapes for quote and total and the charge-line definition are unchanged from 1.0 (see that record). Replaces the current agreement for every supplied charge set regardless of service dates.

Credit rules (release 2.0): uncapped credit per line = floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100), rounded down separately per line. Cap = 3000 cents shared by all lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; distinct pairs (including the same subscription_id under different accounts) have independent caps. Priority within a cap group: largest charge_cents first, ties by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order); service_on plays no role. Each line gets its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get only the remainder or zero. total_credit = sum of assigned credits; line amount due = charge - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit.

Example: quote with omitted release, charge_cents 19999 -> {"release":"2.0","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000,"line_id":"L-1"}. Empty total with release "2.0" -> {"release":"2.0","credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}.

statement command (added by issue trial-tyq; a consumer of this agreement, not a new agreement): request {"command":"statement","lines":[LINE,...]} with optional release. Response has exactly release, lines, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; each response line has exactly line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; lines keep the input order (priority only decides credit assignment, never output order). Overall credit_cents and amount_due_cents equal the total command for the same input. Empty lines -> {"release":"2.0","lines":[],"credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}. Example: one line charge 19999 -> {"release":"2.0","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000,"lines":[{"line_id":"L-1","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000}]}. Statement with explicit release "1.0" is accepted and computed under the original 1.0 agreement (1.0 cap scope per account_id, 1.0 priority by earliest service_on then line_id), reporting release "1.0"; confirmed by issue trial-525 (partner itemized receipts) and recorded in detail under key meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement. Statement with omitted release stays 2.0.

Implementation: main.py RELEASES table holds rate_percent, cap_cents, group_key and priority per release; CURRENT_RELEASE = "2.0"; assign_credits(lines, release=CURRENT_RELEASE) is the shared engine for quote(), total() and statement(). Verified 2026-09-07 by tests/test_release_2.py, tests/test_quote.py, tests/test_total.py, tests/test_statement.py, tests/test_smoke.py (56 tests) and public_tests/release_1_quote.json, release_1_total.json, release_1_statement.json, release_2_quote_total.json, release_2_statement.json (all passing).

  object on stdout; run python3 main.py. Preserve {"command":"ping"} ->

  within a request. A subscription is identified by the pair (account_id,     
  subscription_id); the same subscription_id can occur under different        
  accounts, and a subscription can have several charge lines. service_on is a 
  valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31.         
  charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. No line is excluded by   
  its service date. Each request is the complete charge set of one            
  independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line    
  collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order means Unicode code-point   
  order. JSON object key order is immaterial; do not add response keys beyond 
  those specified.                                                            
                                                                              
  Release "1.0" is the initial agreement. An omitted release selects the      
  current agreement; an explicit supported release selects that version.

  name a specific release and send explicit release values, so their          
  expectations remain applicable when the current agreement changes. Run a    
  supplied suite with python3 test_public.py --cases PATH.

  commands and approved agreements remain unchanged.

  charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. The 3000-cent credit
  cap is shared by all lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair.
  Distinct groups have independent caps. Within each cap group, credit is     
  assigned to lines in this priority: largest charge_cents first; equal       
  charges use increasing line_id. Each line receives its uncapped credit up to

  lines, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents. Return one response line per
